description: This file is a PHP class definition for the Bestseller extension module in OpenCart. It manages database operations related to product bestsellers, including installation, uninstallation, editing, deletion, and reporting.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: PHP class for managing bestseller product data in OpenCart, including creating and dropping tables, updating totals, deleting entries, and generating reports.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the database table for storing bestseller products.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the bestseller products database table.

methods.name: editTotal
methods.description: Updates the total sales for a specific product.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a product from the bestseller list.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bestseller products ordered by total sales with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of bestseller products.
